facts.label: Passado simples e would like
facts.sub: Conte o passado com verbos regulares e irregulares: looked, gave, didn’t find. Peça com I’d like e ofereça com Would you like…?

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Verbos regulares ganham -ed: looked, loved, asked. Verbos irregulares mudam: give vira gave, find vira found, buy vira bought. Use yesterday e last year para marcar o tempo.

facts.label: Didn’t
facts.sub: Para dizer que algo não aconteceu, use didn’t + verbo base: I didn’t find anything. Não coloque o verbo no passado depois de didn’t.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Ontem não achei nada”, e o verbo vem no passado.

items.s: We use did + base verb for questions in the past.
The past of give is gived.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

answers: We use did + base verb for questions in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The past of give is gived. → Falso (It is gave.)

paragraphs: It is Thursday morning in a small shop in Cork. Soft music plays near the door. Clara walks in with a long list. The worker Dale puts books on a shelf. Clara looks tired. Dale smiles and asks about her day.
“Good morning! Can I help you?” says Dale. “Yes. Yesterday I looked for a gift for my mother, but I didn’t find anything.” says Clara. “When is her birthday?” says Dale.
